# Third-party assets - provenance

Every file listed below comes from a Kenney.nl pack released under **Creative Commons Zero 1.0 (CC0)**,
which permits personal and commercial use and makes credit optional. `LICENSE_CC0.txt` is the licence
text shipped inside the packs themselves, copied here verbatim rather than paraphrased.

`sha256` is the first 16 hex characters of the file as it sits in this repository, so a later reader can
prove the committed file is the file that was downloaded.

**These assets do not cover the player or the three enemies.** Those keep the generated sprites from
`tools/art/generate_sprites.py`, because Kenney's top-down character packs fail this project's silhouette
requirement - rendered flat black, the zombie and robot sprites are near-identical ovals. That was
measured before anything was wired in and is recorded as finding F03-21.
